cohort: The study examined 76 pregnant women diagnosed with Pregnancy Induced Hypertension (PIH) who presented to a tertiary care hospital.
finding: The study found that PIH frequently affected pregnant patients, with higher incidence among women from rural areas, those without formal education, and young primigravidas.
mod_finding: Among PIH cases, the majority (71.45%) were delivered by caesarean section, while 25.25% had vaginal deliveries.
